d: Spiky, upward-swept hair in shades of crimson and orange, paired with glowing amber eyes in a sharp, mischievous expression. The face appears as a mature adult with pointed elf-like ears and a smirk revealing pointed teeth, set on a lean, athletic build. This creature wears an ornate, asymmetrical outfit featuring a high golden collar, flowing deep purple and red fabrics, and a large pleated fan-like garment on the back, accented by gold armor on the wrist and ankle. BODY COLOR: Greyish-purple with red swirling markings LEGS: Digitigrade with dark purple skin and three-toed cloven hooves
